title: Surface chemistry-engineered perovskite quantum dot photovoltaics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01107D, Review Article
Xuliang Zhang, Hehe Huang, Chenyu Zhao, Jianyu Yuan
This review summarizes the progress and provides perspectives on perovskite quantum dot photovoltaics, with a focus on surface chemistry engineering, paving a new direction for large-area and low-cost PV technology to address major energy challenges.
